'''Hokuum stations''' dispensed nonliquid stimulants such as [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] and other forms of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. They were found in [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[Cantina|bars]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
